name: Variable Serves as Timer
hint: A variable used as a counter in a timed loop helps make durations and repeated progress explicit.
instruction: Initialize the variable, wait for a fixed interval inside the loop, and update its value after each interval.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
set [my variable v] to (20)
forever
wait (1) seconds
change [my variable v] by (-1)
end
